audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys are boilerplate and contradict the content layer — Level 1 says your Q-poke wins while the side is Fiora and the content says Granite Shield is what wins it.
audit.why: Granite Shield absorbs the opening Lunge and first vital, which is the actual level-1 mechanic; the generic Q-poke line is not true here.
audit.corrected: Level 1 and Levels 4-5 whys rewritten to the real mechanics with Riposte's cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 why is generic and does not mention that Riposte parries Unstoppable Force.
audit.why: Riposte parries all incoming damage and stuns if it blocks an immobilizing effect, so an unbaited ult hands her the kill — the content layer already says this, the full layer did not.
audit.corrected: Level 6 why now sequences the ult behind baiting the 24s parry.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions and the cooldown block name Riposte but carry no numbers, and nothing states that stacking HP feeds her vitals.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 down to 16s at rank 5; Lunge 13s to 6s; Bladework 11s to 7s; Grand Challenge 110/90/70. Duelist's Dance vitals are percent-max-HP true damage, so raw HP is the wrong stat.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns added and the HP-versus-vitals Don't rewritten to say what it actually means.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grand Challenge's heal is never mentioned, so no Grievous Wounds timing is given.
audit.why: Grand Challenge heals Fiora and her allies when the target dies or all four vitals land — anti-heal has to be applied before she commits, not after.
audit.corrected: Late-game breakdown now names the heal and the Grievous timing.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Fiora contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Granite Shield absorbs her opening Lunge and first vital, so the trade she wants never starts. Last-hit through it, give no vital angle.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riposte's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 — the moment she burns it on your Ground Slam, walk up and Thunderclap. While it is held, give her nothing at all.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is a teamfight win button — the lane is just where you bank it. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Fiora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Never open with Unstoppable Force here — Riposte parries it and stuns you. Bait the 24s parry with an auto or Seismic Shard first, then commit the knock-up.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries your R + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte (W): 24s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — parries your R and stuns, so bait it. - Lunge (Q): 13s down to 6s, her only gap-close. - Grand Challenge (R): 110/90/70. - Your ultimate: 130s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries your R + stuns. Bait it. When it is down — R-W-E her.
edits.after: Riposte parries Unstoppable Force and stuns you — bait the 24s cooldown before you engage.

edits.before: Parries your R + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Parries your R and stuns you, 24s at rank 1. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Trading with your passive shield down — that shield IS your trade margin; without it you are paying full price.
edits.after: Duelist's Dance vitals are percent-max-HP true damage — flat HP feeds them, so buy armour and space the vital instead.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is a teamfight win button — build your teamfight around that. Fiora carry threat: 10/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is your teamfight button — flank with it. Grand Challenge heals her and her allies off the execute, so Grievous Wounds must be on before she commits, not after.

edits.before: Both of you are weak at 2 — she gets a vital but your shield and W coming next stage keep it even.
edits.after: Her level-2 vital plus Lunge (13s at rank 1) still beats you, but Granite Shield keeps it small.

notes: Level chart conflict: the packet's levelChart for this matchup reads Malphite/Skill/Malphite/Malphite/Fiora/Malphite/Skill while both layers on disk give Fiora six of seven stages, and the Emerald+ win rate is 56.8% over 970 games. I did not touch any side values — see questionsForUser. Malphite's kit file derives a 'grounding' flag on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam that Riot's descriptions do not support; no grounding claim written.
